description:
## Tantan 7.5.4 — telemetry kill + nag cleanup wave

- FoxStatistics core/uploaders, GAID, OneID createid+storage, GA4 collection, FB auto-events disabled (DEX-verified)
- Ad-click URL device-id substitution neutered (qm60.F); AdMob init + UMP consent form killed
- Carousel/official-advert/incentive-ad dialogs repaired (were silent no-ops)
- Notification-permission, post-swipe marketing, home operation-activity, profile-completeness nags suppressed
- Chat-history search + per-contact chat backgrounds/nicknames unlocked
- Discovery online/popular theme blur regression fixed; roaming location cap removed; ProfileLike quota display
- Me-tab promotion badge + incomplete-profile dot suppressed; push_largepic AB override reverted
- Premium Unlock made 7.5.4-compatible (safe matchAllOrNull, inner-class-hijack-proof resolver anchors)
- All 13 patches apply to 7.5.4 (2754010); new/changed targets DEX-verified on 7.5.4
